summary: This bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to lower the interest rate on all federal student loans to 2 percent, automatically modifying existing loans held by the Secretary of Education and refinancing other federal student loans into direct consolidation loans at the new rate, unless a borrower opts out.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on student loans, specifically lowering interest rates and modifying/refinancing federal student loans. This directly impacts the affordability of higher education for students, which is a core aspect of education policy. By reducing the cost of borrowing, it effectively makes higher education more accessible and less financially burdensome, aligning with the 'more spending on public schools' end of the spectrum in terms of making education more affordable for students.
